tei:div.tei:p: 1) ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ ye shes kyi mkha' gro ma kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo'i zab gter chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi glegs bam/ waṃ)rtags can 'dir/ snyan brgyud rdo rje phag mo'i zab rgyud ldeb/ rdo rje phag mo'i rdzogs rim gsang ba thugs kyi rgya can shin tu zab pa mkha' spyod myur lam 'od gsal mngon gyur ldeb/ yang gsang bla med sngags lam phyag rgya gnyis ldan mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud zab lam snying po ldeb/ sbyor sgrol dgongs pa'i zab gnad ldeb/ rdzogs chen mtha' grol klong yangs kyi dgongs pa 'od gsal sgron me ldeb/ thod rgal gyi gdams pa 'ja' lus mngon grub ldeb/ 'od gsal don gyi snying po nam mkha' klong yangs ldeb/ thod rgal 'ja' lus mngon 'grub kyi pra khrid sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor 'od gsal snying po ldeb/ bcas/ ༈ mtsho rgyal skor la/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gsol 2)'debs rmongs pa kun sel shes rab gsal byed ldeb/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsdus pa ldeb/ sngon 'gro'i las rim dngos grub sgo 'byed dang*/ bla rdo srog 'khor dngos grub bum bzang*/ bla rdo gsang rgya can dngos grub gter bum bcas la ldeb/ sgrub thabs dngos grub dpal ster ldeb/ gsang sgrub rgyun khyer snying po ldeb/ tshogs mchod dngos grub char 'bebs ldeb/ me mchod gsang ba'i rgya can ldeb/ tshogs bskang sun zlog ldeb/ sgrub thabs byin rlabs myur 'thob gsang rgya can dang*/ tshogs mchod rgyun khyer snying po bcas ldeb/ sgrub thabs yang bcud snying po shin tu zab pa ldeb/ mtsho rgyal gsang dbang 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang ldeb/ gsang mdzod cha lag gnad yig bsdus pa ldeb/ bcas/ ༈ rtsa gsum spyir gces pa'i skor la/ cho ga spyi'i mtshams sbyor bsdus pa dngos grub bum bzang ldeb/ rtsa gsum spyi'i dkar gtor 'dod dgu kun 'byung dang*/ sngon 'gro'i 'jug sgo zab mo/

mchod rdzas byin 3)rlabs bsdus pa/ mtshams lha bskyed pa/ gnam phud bdud rtsi kun khyab bcas la ldeb/ gsang mdzod cha lag sa chog sngon 'gro/ bum sgrub/ gsang dbang sgo 'byed/ sngon 'gro'i spyi gces bcas la ldeb/ snyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i dmigs rim dngos grub snye ma ldeb/ rtsa gsum spyi'i dbang bzhi 'brel tshad don ldan mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud ldeb/ rtsa gsum spyi'i me mchod las bzhi lhun grub rin chen bang mdzod ldeb/ las bzhi'i thig yig a r+sha ldeb/ dngos grub len chog 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs ldeb/ bcas/ ༈ 'jam dbyangs skor la/ bī mas zhal gzigs 'jam dbyangs sgrub thabs zab rgya can ldeb/ sgrub thabs shes rab nyi ma dang*/ a ti'i lugs spros med rgyun khyer/ mngon rtogs bsdus pa bcas la ldeb/ rtsa sgrub shes rab blo 'phel ldeb/ rgyun khyer tshogs mchod bsdus pa ldeb/ gtor 'bul dngos grub bum 4)bzang ldeb/ bcas/ ༈ sgrub thabs sna tshogs dang*/ zhal gdams/ rtogs brjod/ dre+i lan/ brtan bzhugs sogs nyer mkho sna tshogs skor la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas bsdus pa ye shes lam bzang ldeb/ gu ru'i sgrub pa byin rlabs bum bzang ldeb/ gro lod sgrub thabs byin rlabs mchog ster ldeb/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i gsang sgrub zab mo ldeb/ ku sā li'i tshogs bsags ldeb/ dbang sdud zil gnon zab mo ldeb/ ku su la'i tshogs bsags phaṭa don lam bzang ldeb/ 'pho ba bde chen lam bzang dang*/ de'i gsol 'debs ye shes lam bzang bcas ldeb/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs myur 'jug bdud rtsi'i thig pa ldeb/ e ma hoḥ rang byung rig pa sogs gter ston yab yum gyi gsol 'debs tshan pa lnga dang*/ bsam lhun/ tshogs bsdus smon lam bcas ldeb/ bla ma rgyang 'bod byin rlabs bcud bum ldeb/ gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung ldeb/ thod rgal gyi zin bris 5)don gsal me long ldeb/

lhun grub rang mal gyi don 'brel tshan pa gnyis la ldeb/ stag lung mkhan po pad dpal gyi dris lan brgyud ldan bla ma sogs ldeb/ smra bsam brjod med sogs brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs zhu ba zhus lan skor can ldeb/ a ho/ grub pa'i dbang phyug sogs sprul sku dri med la phul ba'i nyams snang rtogs brjod sna tshogs skor tshan pa dgu can la ldeb/ brda don 'brel ba rdo rje'i gad mo zhes nang gses tshan pa bdun can nyams snang sogs kyi skor la ldeb/ e ma skal ldan rig pa sogs spros med don dbang ngo sprod dang*/ nyams blangs mtshar glu bcas ldeb/ shes rab dbang mos bde ba'i rdo rje la smras pa sogs zhal gdams rtogs brjod/ gsol 'debs/ rgyud bskul smon tshig bcas nang gses tshan pa bzhi la ldeb/ gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung dang*/ bar do'i mthong snang nges 'byung gsal sgron/ shes rab lha mo dang bu slob rnams 6) la gdams pa'i zhal gdams bslab bya dpe tshan gnyis can bcas la ldeb/ thod rgal 'ja' lus mngon 'grub kyi skabs don las 'phros dogs sel tshul khrims rdo rje'i zin bris can ldeb/ dpal ri'i smon lam bsdus pa thugs rje'i lcags kyu ldeb/ mkha' spyod zhing bgrod smon lam byang chub lam bzang ldeb/ smon lam dpag bsam rgyas pa yid bzhin dpal ster ldeb/ 2 rdzogs chen gsang lam smon lam kun bzang thugs thig ldeb/ seng chen gsol 'debs byin rlabs 'od dkar ldeb/ bcas/ ༈ srung ma'i skor la/ dregs pa rnam gsum gsol bsdus dngos grub kun 'byung ldeb/ srog gi spu gri'i rtsa sgrub phrin las myur mgyogs dang*/ bka' srung sna tshogs kyi gsol bsdus nang gses tshan pa nyi shu can la ldeb/ gter srung lha rabs g.yul rgyal gyi gsol mchod phrin las lhun grub ldeb/ klu bsang 'dod rgu'i dpal ster dang*/ gter gnas ngos 'dzin bcas ldeb/ rig 'dus tshogs mchod 'don 'grigs ldeb/

mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod sgrub skor rnams kyi cho ga'i phyag rgya'i zin bris ldeb/ bcas le tshan brgyad cu gya drug dang 7) glegs bam gyi dkar chag rang nyid ldeb/ bcas bsdoms ldeb grangs/ bzhugs/ mtshungs med ḍā ki bde skyong dbang mo yi// zab gter mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chos sde'i gzhung*// rig 'dzin dbang mos spar du btab spel mthus// zab chos phrin las mi nub mthar rgyas shog/ grub brnyes rig 'dzin ḍā ki'i 'khor los sgyur// sngon med gdams zab mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod bdag /mkha' spyod dbang mo bde ba'i rdo rje yi// ring lugs phyogs mthar 'phel rgyas rtag khyab shog
